title: The happy secret to better work | Shawn Achor
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】更好工作的快樂秘訣|肖恩·阿喬（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: When I was seven years old and my sister was just five years old,
cues.en: When I was seven years old and my sister was just five years old,
cues.zh: 當我七歲，我妹妹才五歲的時候，

cues.text: we were playing on top of a bunk bed.
cues.en: we were playing on top of a bunk bed.
cues.zh: 我們在雙層床上玩耍。

cues.text: I was two years older than my sister at the time -- I mean, I'm two years older than her now --
cues.en: I was two years older than my sister at the time -- I mean, I'm two years older than her now --
cues.zh: 當時我比我姊姊大兩歲——我是說，我現在比她大兩歲——

cues.text: but at the time it meant she had to do everything that I wanted to do, and I wanted to play war.
cues.en: but at the time it meant she had to do everything that I wanted to do, and I wanted to play war.
cues.zh: 但當時這意味著她必須做我想做的一切，而我想玩戰爭。

cues.text: So we were up on top of our bunk beds.
cues.en: So we were up on top of our bunk beds.
cues.zh: 所以我們躺在雙層床上。

cues.text: And on one side of the bunk bed, I had put out all of my G.I. Joe soldiers and weaponry.
cues.en: And on one side of the bunk bed, I had put out all of my G.I. Joe soldiers and weaponry.
cues.zh: 在雙層床的一側，我把我所有的退伍軍人物品都拿出來了。喬士兵和武器裝備。

cues.text: And on the other side were all my sister's My Little Ponies ready for a cavalry charge.
cues.en: And on the other side were all my sister's My Little Ponies ready for a cavalry charge.
cues.zh: 另一邊，我姊姊的所有小馬駒都做好了騎兵衝鋒的準備。

cues.text: There are differing accounts of what actually happened that afternoon, but since my sister is not here with us today,
cues.en: There are differing accounts of what actually happened that afternoon, but since my sister is not here with us today,
cues.zh: 對於那天下午實際發生的事情有不同的說法，但由於我姐姐今天沒有和我們在一起，

cues.text: let me tell you the true story -- which is my sister's a little on the clumsy side.
cues.en: let me tell you the true story -- which is my sister's a little on the clumsy side.
cues.zh: 讓我告訴你真實的故事——這是我姐姐有點笨拙的故事。

cues.text: Somehow, without any help or push from her older brother at all, Amy disappeared off of the top of the bunk bed
cues.en: Somehow, without any help or push from her older brother at all, Amy disappeared off of the top of the bunk bed
cues.zh: 不知何故，在沒有哥哥的任何幫助或推動的情況下，艾米從雙層床的頂部消失了

cues.text: and landed with this crash on the floor.
cues.en: and landed with this crash on the floor.
cues.zh: 並以這次撞擊的方式降落在地板上。

cues.text: I nervously peered over the side of the bed to see what had befallen my fallen sister
cues.en: I nervously peered over the side of the bed to see what had befallen my fallen sister
cues.zh: 我緊張地從床邊往外看，想看看倒下的妹妹發生了什麼事。

cues.text: and saw that she had landed painfully on her hands and knees on all fours on the ground.
cues.en: and saw that she had landed painfully on her hands and knees on all fours on the ground.
cues.zh: 只見她痛苦地四肢著地，雙手雙膝著地。

cues.text: I was nervous because my parents had charged me with making sure that my sister and I
cues.en: I was nervous because my parents had charged me with making sure that my sister and I
cues.zh: 我很緊張，因為我的父母責成我確保我和姐姐

cues.text: played as safely and as quietly as possible.
cues.en: played as safely and as quietly as possible.
cues.zh: 盡可能安全、安靜地玩耍。

cues.text: And seeing as how I had accidentally broken Amy's arm
cues.en: And seeing as how I had accidentally broken Amy's arm
cues.zh: 看看我是如何不小心折斷了艾米的手臂

cues.text: just one week before -- heroically pushing her out of the way of an oncoming imaginary sniper bullet,
cues.en: just one week before -- heroically pushing her out of the way of an oncoming imaginary sniper bullet,
cues.zh: 就在一週前──英勇地把她推開了迎面而來的想像中的狙擊子彈，

cues.text: for which I have yet to be thanked, I was trying as hard as I could --
cues.en: for which I have yet to be thanked, I was trying as hard as I could --
cues.zh: 為此我還沒有得到感謝，我已經盡力了——

cues.text: she didn't even see it coming -- I was trying hard to be on my best behavior.
cues.en: she didn't even see it coming -- I was trying hard to be on my best behavior.
cues.zh: 她甚至沒有預見到這一點——我正在努力表現出最好的表現。

cues.text: And I saw my sister's face, this wail of pain and suffering and surprise
cues.en: And I saw my sister's face, this wail of pain and suffering and surprise
cues.zh: 我看到了姊姊的臉，那是痛苦、折磨和驚訝的哀號

cues.text: threatening to erupt from her mouth and wake my parents from the long winter's nap for which they had settled.
cues.en: threatening to erupt from her mouth and wake my parents from the long winter's nap for which they had settled.
cues.zh: 威脅要從她嘴裡噴出來，把我父母從他們已經習慣的漫長冬眠中吵醒。

cues.text: So I did the only thing my frantic seven year-old brain could think to do to avert this tragedy.
cues.en: So I did the only thing my frantic seven year-old brain could think to do to avert this tragedy.
cues.zh: 所以我做了我那瘋狂的七歲大腦所能想到的唯一一件事來避免這場悲劇。

cues.text: And if you have children, you've seen this hundreds of times.
cues.en: And if you have children, you've seen this hundreds of times.
cues.zh: 如果你有孩子，你已經見過數百次這種情況了。

cues.text: I said, "Amy, wait. Don't cry. Did you see how you landed?
cues.en: I said, "Amy, wait. Don't cry. Did you see how you landed?
cues.zh: 我說：「艾米，等等。別哭。你看到你是怎麼著陸的嗎？

cues.text: No human lands on all fours like that.
cues.en: No human lands on all fours like that.
cues.zh: 沒有人類能像這樣用四肢著地。

cues.text: Amy, I think this means you're a unicorn." Now, that was cheating,
cues.en: Amy, I think this means you're a unicorn." Now, that was cheating,
cues.zh: 艾米，我認為這意味著你是獨角獸。 」 現在，那是作弊，

cues.text: because there was nothing she would want more than not to be Amy the hurt five year-old little sister,
cues.en: because there was nothing she would want more than not to be Amy the hurt five year-old little sister,
cues.zh: 因為她最想要的就是不要成為艾米那個受傷的五歲小妹妹，

cues.text: but Amy the special unicorn.
cues.en: but Amy the special unicorn.
cues.zh: 但艾米是特殊的獨角獸。

cues.text: Of course, this option was open to her brain at no point in the past.
cues.en: Of course, this option was open to her brain at no point in the past.
cues.zh: 當然，她的大腦在過去從未有過這種選擇。

cues.text: And you could see how my poor, manipulated sister faced conflict, as her little brain attempted to devote resources
cues.en: And you could see how my poor, manipulated sister faced conflict, as her little brain attempted to devote resources
cues.zh: 你可以看到我可憐的、被操縱的妹妹如何面對衝突，因為她的小大腦試圖投入資源

cues.text: to feeling the pain and suffering and surprise she just experienced, or contemplating her new-found identity as a unicorn.
cues.en: to feeling the pain and suffering and surprise she just experienced, or contemplating her new-found identity as a unicorn.
cues.zh: 感受她剛經歷的痛苦和驚喜，或思考她作為獨角獸的新身分。

cues.text: And the latter won.
cues.en: And the latter won.
cues.zh: 而後者獲勝了。

cues.text: Instead of crying or ceasing our play, instead of waking my parents, with all the negative consequences for me,
cues.en: Instead of crying or ceasing our play, instead of waking my parents, with all the negative consequences for me,
cues.zh: 不要哭泣或停止玩耍，不要叫醒我的父母，以免給我帶來所有負面後果，

cues.text: a smile spread across her face and she scrambled back up onto the bunk bed
cues.en: a smile spread across her face and she scrambled back up onto the bunk bed
cues.zh: 她臉上露出笑容，然後爬回雙層床上

cues.text: with all the grace of a baby unicorn -- with one broken leg.
cues.en: with all the grace of a baby unicorn -- with one broken leg.
cues.zh: 帶著小獨角獸的優雅──一條腿斷了。

cues.text: What we stumbled across at this tender age of just five and seven --
cues.en: What we stumbled across at this tender age of just five and seven --
cues.zh: 我們在五歲和七歲的年紀偶然發現了——

cues.text: we had no idea at the time -- was going be at the vanguard of a scientific revolution
cues.en: we had no idea at the time -- was going be at the vanguard of a scientific revolution
cues.zh: 我們當時並不知道──我們將成為科學革命的先鋒

cues.text: occurring two decades later in the way that we look at the human brain.
cues.en: occurring two decades later in the way that we look at the human brain.
cues.zh: 二十年後以我們看待人類大腦的方式發生了。

cues.text: We had stumbled across something called positive psychology, which is the reason I'm here today
cues.en: We had stumbled across something called positive psychology, which is the reason I'm here today
cues.zh: 我們偶然發現了一種叫做正向心理學的東西，這就是我今天來這裡的原因

cues.text: and the reason that I wake up every morning.
cues.en: and the reason that I wake up every morning.
cues.zh: 以及我每天早上醒來的原因。

cues.text: When I started talking about this research outside of academia, with companies and schools,
cues.en: When I started talking about this research outside of academia, with companies and schools,
cues.zh: 當我開始在學術界之外、與公司和學校談論這項研究時，

cues.text: the first thing they said to never do is to start with a graph.
cues.en: the first thing they said to never do is to start with a graph.
cues.zh: 他們說永遠不要做的第一件事就是從圖表開始。

cues.text: The first thing I want to do is start with a graph.
cues.en: The first thing I want to do is start with a graph.
cues.zh: 我想做的第一件事是從圖表開始。

cues.text: This graph looks boring, but it is the reason I get excited and wake up every morning.
cues.en: This graph looks boring, but it is the reason I get excited and wake up every morning.
cues.zh: 這張圖看起來很無聊，但這就是我每天早上興奮醒來的原因。

cues.text: And this graph doesn't even mean anything; it's fake data.
cues.en: And this graph doesn't even mean anything; it's fake data.
cues.zh: 這張圖根本沒有任何意義；這是假資料。

cues.text: What we found is -- If I got this data studying you, I would be thrilled,
cues.en: What we found is -- If I got this data studying you, I would be thrilled,
cues.zh: 我們發現──如果我得到這些研究你的資料，我會很興奮，

cues.text: because there's a trend there, and that means that I can get published,
cues.en: because there's a trend there, and that means that I can get published,
cues.zh: 因為那裡有一種趨勢，這意味著我可以發表，

cues.text: which is all that really matters.
cues.en: which is all that really matters.
cues.zh: 這才是真正重要的。

cues.text: There is one weird red dot above the curve, there's one weirdo in the room --
cues.en: There is one weird red dot above the curve, there's one weirdo in the room --
cues.zh: 曲線上方有一個奇怪的紅點，房間裡有個怪人——

cues.text: I know who you are, I saw you earlier -- that's no problem.
cues.en: I know who you are, I saw you earlier -- that's no problem.
cues.zh: 我知道你是誰，我早些時候見過你——那沒問題。

cues.text: That's no problem, as most of you know, because I can just delete that dot.
cues.en: That's no problem, as most of you know, because I can just delete that dot.
cues.zh: 正如你們大多數人所知，這沒問題，因為我可以刪除那個點。

cues.text: I can delete that dot because that's clearly a measurement error.
cues.en: I can delete that dot because that's clearly a measurement error.
cues.zh: 我可以刪除那個點，因為這顯然是一個測量錯誤。

cues.text: And we know that's a measurement error because it's messing up my data.
cues.en: And we know that's a measurement error because it's messing up my data.
cues.zh: 我們知道這是一個測量錯誤，因為它弄亂了我的資料。

cues.text: So one of the first things we teach people in economics, statistics, business and psychology courses
cues.en: So one of the first things we teach people in economics, statistics, business and psychology courses
cues.zh: 因此，我們在經濟學、統計學、商業和心理學課程中教給人們的第一件事就是

cues.text: is how, in a statistically valid way, do we eliminate the weirdos.
cues.en: is how, in a statistically valid way, do we eliminate the weirdos.
cues.zh: 就是我們如何以統計上有效的方式消除怪人。

cues.text: How do we eliminate the outliers so we can find the line of best fit?
cues.en: How do we eliminate the outliers so we can find the line of best fit?
cues.zh: 我們如何消除異常值以便找到最佳擬合線？

cues.text: Which is fantastic if I'm trying to find out how many Advil the average person should be taking -- two.
cues.en: Which is fantastic if I'm trying to find out how many Advil the average person should be taking -- two.
cues.zh: 如果我想知道一般人應該服用多少 Advil（兩片），那就太棒了。

cues.text: But if I'm interested in your potential, or for happiness or productivity or energy or creativity,
cues.en: But if I'm interested in your potential, or for happiness or productivity or energy or creativity,
cues.zh: 但如果我對你的潛力感興趣，或對幸福、生產力、精力或創造力感興趣，

cues.text: we're creating the cult of the average with science.
cues.en: we're creating the cult of the average with science.
cues.zh: 我們正在用科學創造普通人的崇拜。

cues.text: If I asked a question like, "How fast can a child learn how to read in a classroom?"
cues.en: If I asked a question like, "How fast can a child learn how to read in a classroom?"
cues.zh: 如果我問這樣的問題：“孩子在教室裡學會閱讀的速度有多快？”

cues.text: scientists change the answer to "How fast does the average child learn how to read in that classroom?"
cues.en: scientists change the answer to "How fast does the average child learn how to read in that classroom?"
cues.zh: 科學家將答案改為“普通孩子在教室裡學習閱讀的速度有多快？”

cues.text: and we tailor the class towards the average.
cues.en: and we tailor the class towards the average.
cues.zh: 我們會根據平均水平調整班級。

cues.text: If you fall below the average, then psychologists get thrilled, because that means you're depressed or have a disorder,
cues.en: If you fall below the average, then psychologists get thrilled, because that means you're depressed or have a disorder,
cues.zh: 如果你的成績低於平均水平，那麼心理學家會很興奮，因為這意味著你有憂鬱症或疾病，

cues.text: or hopefully both.
cues.en: or hopefully both.
cues.zh: 或希望兩者兼而有之。

cues.text: We're hoping for both because our business model is, if you come into a therapy session with one problem,
cues.en: We're hoping for both because our business model is, if you come into a therapy session with one problem,
cues.zh: 我們希望兩者都能實現，因為我們的商業模式是，如果你帶著一個問題參加治療，

cues.text: we want to make sure you leave knowing you have ten, so you keep coming back.
cues.en: we want to make sure you leave knowing you have ten, so you keep coming back.
cues.zh: 我們希望確保您離開時知道自己有十個，這樣您就會不斷回來。

cues.text: We'll go back into your childhood if necessary, but eventually we want to make you normal again.
cues.en: We'll go back into your childhood if necessary, but eventually we want to make you normal again.
cues.zh: 如有必要，我們會回到你的童年，但最終我們想讓你恢復正常。

cues.text: But normal is merely average.
cues.en: But normal is merely average.
cues.zh: 但正常只是平均。

cues.text: And positive psychology posits that if we study what is merely average, we will remain merely average.
cues.en: And positive psychology posits that if we study what is merely average, we will remain merely average.
cues.zh: 正向心理學認為，如果我們只是研究平均水平，我們就只能保持平均水平。

cues.text: Then instead of deleting those positive outliers, what I intentionally do is come into a population like this one
cues.en: Then instead of deleting those positive outliers, what I intentionally do is come into a population like this one
cues.zh: 然後，我沒有刪除那些正面的異常值，而是有意做的是進入像這樣的人群

cues.text: and say, why?
cues.en: and say, why?
cues.zh: 並說，為什麼？

cues.text: Why are some of you high above the curve in terms of intellectual, athletic, musical ability,
cues.en: Why are some of you high above the curve in terms of intellectual, athletic, musical ability,
cues.zh: 為什麼你們中的一些人在智力、運動、音樂能力方面都高於曲線，

cues.text: creativity, energy levels, resiliency in the face of challenge, sense of humor?
cues.en: creativity, energy levels, resiliency in the face of challenge, sense of humor?
cues.zh: 創造力、精力水平、面對挑戰的彈性、幽默感？

cues.text: Whatever it is, instead of deleting you, what I want to do is study you.
cues.en: Whatever it is, instead of deleting you, what I want to do is study you.
cues.zh: 不管怎樣，我不想刪除你，而是想研究你。

cues.text: Because maybe we can glean information, not just how to move people up to the average,
cues.en: Because maybe we can glean information, not just how to move people up to the average,
cues.zh: 因為也許我們可以收集資訊，而不僅僅是如何讓人們達到平均水平，

cues.text: but move the entire average up in our companies and schools worldwide.
cues.en: but move the entire average up in our companies and schools worldwide.
cues.zh: 但提高我們全球公司和學校的整體平均水平。

cues.text: The reason this graph is important to me is, on the news, the majority of the information is not positive.
cues.en: The reason this graph is important to me is, on the news, the majority of the information is not positive.
cues.zh: 這張圖對我來說很重要的原因是，在新聞中，大多數資訊都不是正面的。

cues.text: in fact it's negative.
cues.en: in fact it's negative.
cues.zh: 事實上它是負面的。

cues.text: Most of it's about murder, corruption, diseases, natural disasters.
cues.en: Most of it's about murder, corruption, diseases, natural disasters.
cues.zh: 其中大部分是關於謀殺、腐敗、疾病、天災。

cues.text: And very quickly, my brain starts to think that's the accurate ratio of negative to positive in the world.
cues.en: And very quickly, my brain starts to think that's the accurate ratio of negative to positive in the world.
cues.zh: 很快，我的大腦開始認為這就是世界上消極與積極的準確比例。

cues.text: This creates "the medical school syndrome." During the first year of medical training,
cues.en: This creates "the medical school syndrome." During the first year of medical training,
cues.zh: 這就造成了「醫學院症候群」。在醫學訓練的第一年，

cues.text: as you read through a list of all the symptoms and diseases, suddenly you realize you have all of them.
cues.en: as you read through a list of all the symptoms and diseases, suddenly you realize you have all of them.
cues.zh: 當您閱讀所有症狀和疾病的清單時，您突然意識到自己患有所有這些症狀和疾病。

cues.text: I have a brother in-law named Bobo, which is a whole other story.
cues.en: I have a brother in-law named Bobo, which is a whole other story.
cues.zh: 我有一個姐夫，名叫波波，這完全是另一回事了。

cues.text: Bobo married Amy the unicorn.
cues.en: Bobo married Amy the unicorn.
cues.zh: 波波與獨角獸艾米結婚了。

cues.text: Bobo called me on the phone -- from Yale Medical School,
cues.en: Bobo called me on the phone -- from Yale Medical School,
cues.zh: 波波打電話給我——來自耶魯醫學院

cues.text: and Bobo said, "Shawn, I have leprosy." Which, even at Yale, is extraordinarily rare.
cues.en: and Bobo said, "Shawn, I have leprosy." Which, even at Yale, is extraordinarily rare.
cues.zh: 波波說：「肖恩，我得了麻風病。」即使在耶魯大學，這也是極為罕見的。

cues.text: But I had no idea how to console poor Bobo because he had just gotten over an entire week of menopause.
cues.en: But I had no idea how to console poor Bobo because he had just gotten over an entire week of menopause.
cues.zh: 但我不知道該如何安慰可憐的波波，因為他剛度過了整整一週的更年期。

cues.text: We're finding it's not necessarily the reality that shapes us, but the lens through which your brain views the world that shapes your reality.
cues.en: We're finding it's not necessarily the reality that shapes us, but the lens through which your brain views the world that shapes your reality.
cues.zh: 我們發現，塑造我們的不一定是現實，而是大腦看待世界的鏡頭塑造了你的現實。

cues.text: And if we can change the lens, not only can we change your happiness, we can change every single educational and business outcome at the same time.
cues.en: And if we can change the lens, not only can we change your happiness, we can change every single educational and business outcome at the same time.
cues.zh: 如果我們能夠改變視角，我們不僅可以改變您的幸福感，還可以同時改變每項教育和商業成果。

cues.text: I applied to Harvard on a dare.
cues.en: I applied to Harvard on a dare.
cues.zh: 我大膽地申請了哈佛。
